Entry Timber and Furs of the North The forests, furs, timber, and amber of the North turn long winters into tradable wealth. White Harbor merchants can load them on ships heading south, but mountain hunters only regard a good skin as winter money for their family; when the roads are frozen, the people closest to the market may not be able to Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
